title: the two detached spawns that hand-built their own flags take them from windowless_spawn, and the site check scans instead of listing
intention: pulse._detached and memory_sync.push take their Popen keywords from detached_kwargs(), and tooth 3 of the windowless_spawn proof finds spawn sites by scanning every non-proof module under cairn/, so a future hand-built flag set reds.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: pulse.py:137-141 sets creationflags 0x08|0x08000000 (no CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP) else start_new_session; its argv is [python, LISTENER, --port, --bind, ...], python by default sys.executable. memory_sync.py:49-51 sets creationflags DETACHED_PROCESS|CREATE_NO_WINDOW else start_new_session and spawns git -C CLONE push -q. The proof's SITES is a hard list of six files that omits both.
traces_to: Law 1 and Law 4 (one helper for the flag set, enforced by a proof that scans rather than a list a hand must keep); Law 3 (a measured defect: akiendell windows); Law 7 (a skipped push is said aloud).
how: Red-first proof with Popen mocked (nothing spawns): each site's flag kwargs equal detached_kwargs(); a planted module that hand-builds flags makes the scan red. pulse.py: kw.update(detached_kwargs()). memory_sync.py is a standalone hook script run by absolute path with no PYTHONPATH, so it adds the repo root to sys.path and imports the helper at call time inside push(); when the import fails it says so on stderr and skips the push (the next SessionStart pull pushes commits that are ahead), never failing the Stop hook.

clauses.claim: pulse._detached, with Popen mocked, passes flag kwargs equal to detached_kwargs() and no other creationflags or start_new_session
memory_sync.push, with Popen mocked, spawns ['git', '-C', CLONE, 'push', '-q'] with flag kwargs equal to detached_kwargs()
the site check scans every non-proof .py under cairn/ for Popen( creationflags= or start_new_session=True and reds a planted module that hand-builds flags or spawns without detached_kwargs
with cairn unimportable, memory_sync.push returns 0 and writes the reason to stderr without spawning, so the Stop hook never fails

decisions.text: D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

The proof's SITES is a hard list of six files that omits both.
measured.how: Read of pulse.py 132-141 and 144-151, memory_sync.py 43-53, the proof's SITES (line 35) and tooth 3 (line 112), memory_link.py's install_hooks (hook command is the absolute script path with no PYTHONPATH)

measured.saw: A console window opening for these two children is NOT measured here; the premise is the orchestrator's: a console window is a window whatever the child is. HYPOTHESIS until tooth 2 of ticket 0156856b1fae has run.
